com.wac.autocore.ui.components

Class BookingFormLayout

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.ui.components.BookingFormLayout

  • public class BookingFormLayout
extends java.lang.Object
    The row layout of the booking form: Vehicle -> Service package -> Services -> Mechanic -> Date & Time -> Description -> Status. In drop-in mode Date & Time is swapped for the time the service works out.
